main_text.l: sed in ferendo patientiam. Epistola pri-
or Vincentio scripta ita se habet: [{y}ter-
losa tentatio: non est tamen Potestas
nisi a Deo, qui autem resistit Potestati,
Dei ordinationi resistit. Vis autem non
bebis laudem ex illa. Sive enim Pote-
laudem habet ex illa qui fuerit emen-
datus, sive inimica veritati in aliquem
saeviat, laudem habet ex illa qui victor
(quod absit) pro errore suo contra ve-
ritatem Leges darent, per quas iusti &
tur, nec a iuramento fidelitatis defice-

page.notes: Left page: "y" is the reference mark in the text and in the margin note "Epist.48." (the note reads "y Epist.48." on the scan). The margin mark beside "166." is printed as an x-like glyph; I read it as z, matching the text mark, so it is uncertain: [?]. The mark "z" in the text before "Posterior" is also a possible misreading. Long s is printed in the scan and is rendered here as plain s. The right page is cropped at the right edge: only the first letters of its lines are visible, so those fragments are incomplete and their readings are uncertain. Its page number and running head are not visible. No catchword, signature or page-foot furniture is visible.
